description: A bare identifier static map key analyzed as a static traversal is a root
notes: The spec says a bare identifier object key is a literal attribute name as opposed to a variable reference, and a static traversal needs a variable expression, but its static map section returns keys with no further interpretation, which can be read as leaving the identifier a variable expression. hashicorp/hcl keeps the identifier as a ScopeTraversalExpr inside an ObjectConsKeyExpr (hclsyntax/expression.go): Value gives the name as a string through hcl.ExprAsKeyword, while AsTraversal gives the traversal of the wrapped expression.
